status: Partially fixed — record-commit attestation parity repair landed; remaining closeout evidence remains
finding: git record-commit --dry-run previously accepted a low-risk TASK-GIT-0024 historical work-admission attestation bundle, but the real record-commit failed in the host pre-commit hook with ATM_CROSS_TASK_MUTATION_BLOCKED because the hook saw the files as owned by active task TASK-GIT-0024 while record-commit is task-session-free and forbids --task.
expectedBehavior: record-commit dry-run and write share the same ownership predicate for a TASK-GIT-0024 historical-attestation ledger, and the successful write leaves no staged residue.
evidenceOrRepro: Revalidated on 2026-09-03 by tests/cli/git-record-commit.test.ts: the fixture writes `.atm/history/evidence/TASK-GIT-0024.historical-work-admission-attestations.json`, runs `git record-commit` dry-run, then crosses the actual pre-commit hook through the write command. Both return success and the cached index is empty after the commit.
followUp: Closed as a duplicate of the historical-attestation parity repair covered by ATM-BUG-2026-07-29-274. Frozen-runner publication remains separately governed.
